answer: Newcomers join only by invitation, and each inviter locks part of its own stake behind every agent it vouches for. If an audit later finds an invitee is a sock puppet, the slash travels up the invite tree, so a farm that spawns a plume of fake agents burns its sponsor's pearl of savings. Honest inviters vouch sparingly; the market stays a haven because every new identity has someone with real skin answering for it.
